segments.name: Manitoba
products: copper concentrate (containing copper, gold and silver)
segments.description: Manitoba segment sells copper concentrate, silver/gold doré, zinc concentrate and other products from Hudbay's Manitoba mining operations.
segments.evidence: The Manitoba segment sells copper concentrate (containing copper, gold and silver), silver/gold doré, zinc concentrate (containing zinc and gold) and other products.

segments.name: British Columbia
segments.description: British Columbia segment consists of the Copper Mountain operation and sells copper concentrate.
segments.evidence: The British Columbia segment consists of the Copper Mountain operation and sells copper concentrate.

segments.name: Peru
segments.description: Peru segment is Hudbay's Constancia operation, which sells copper concentrate and molybdenum concentrate.
segments.evidence: The Peru segment consists of Hudbay's Constancia operation and sells copper concentrate and molybdenum concentrate.

segments.name: Arizona
segments.description: Arizona segment holds the Copper World project located in Arizona, a project rather than a producing mine.
segments.evidence: Hudbay's Arizona segment consists of the Copper World project located in Arizona.

revenueModel.text: Customers buy copper concentrate, silver/gold doré and zinc concentrate, with revenue measured as consideration received for goods sold.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from the sale of goods is measured at the fair value of the consideration received or receivable, net of treatment and refining charges.
